final_claim_boundary.what_this_repair_pass_established: All six code-level blockers/repairs (B1, B2, B3, M2, M3, M4) are implemented and pass every synthetic/structural verification test devised for them. The apparatus, AS CODE, is now substantially more sound than the pre-repair design: token budgets are explicit and equal, BASE_N exists with a genuinely comparable (not copy-pasted, not wildly divergent) synthesis mechanism, model identity is no longer asymmetrically leaked to council's synthesis, model selection is genuinely pinned across the whole study including ARCH_PIPELINE's own internal call, truncation has a real ground-truth-based classification (for 3 of 4 arms) plus a uniform backstop (for all 4), and arm order is randomized and reproducibly recorded per task.

Zero real generation calls completed in this session's sanity run. BASE_N's synthesis prompt has never synthesized a real response. The truncation classifier has never classified a real truncated response under the new code. This is not a minor gap -- the mission's own explicit deliverable structure requires a development sanity check BEFORE any verdict of readiness, and that check did not complete, for reasons (live production Ollama contention) outside this mission's authorized remedies.
final_claim_boundary.recommended_next_action: Re-attempt the identical development-set sanity check (task_11/task_12 only, still no held-out data) at a time when live production contention is lower, or accept a longer, patient, unattended background run and inspect audits/tier3_apparatus/dev_sanity_results.jsonl once it has produced at least one complete record per arm per task (8 total) before declaring the apparatus genuinely ready.
